description: Access to information and application system functions is not restricted according to access control policy.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not enforce access restrictions to information and application functions based on defined access control policies, including lack of role-based access control (RBAC), attribute-based access control (ABAC), or need-to-know principles.

metadata.detection_notes: Review access control policies, implemented access controls in applications and systems, permission matrices, role definitions, access provisioning workflows, and enforcement mechanisms for least privilege and need-to-know.
